newsitem.title: TURKEY: Fourteen killed in Turkish bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Fourteen killed in Turkish bus crash.

text.p: Fourteen people died on Thursday when a minibus carrying farm workers collided with a lorry loaded with vegetables in southwestern Turkey, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
The accident, in which a further 14 were seriously injured, took place at around 8 p.m. (1700 GMT) near the southwestern town of Isparta. The injured have been taken to local hospitals.
